questions.prompt: Which spot is a clear value bet?

choices.text: Heads-up, in position, top pair top kicker on a dry board.
Four-way, ace-high on a wet board
Out of position, bottom pair facing a raise

questions.explanation: Value needs a hand that is ahead and a field that can call worse. The other spots are air or dominated.

questions.prompt: Which spot is a clear check?

choices.text: In position with no pair and no draw on a board that favors the caller.
A set on a wet board
Top pair on a dry board heads-up

questions.explanation: Air without fold equity checks. Strong hands bet.

choices.text: Calling a pot-size bet out of position with bottom pair, multiway.
Calling a small bet with a nut flush draw
Betting top pair on a dry board
Folding air to a large bet

questions.explanation: The price and the number of players make bottom pair a fold.

questions.prompt: A flop plan is complete only when you also know…

choices.text: What you will do if you are raised or if the turn is a blank.

questions.explanation: One action is not a line. Strong players pick the flop bet and the turn plan together.
